knowledge:
- key_parameters: coldata=A data frame containing files (path to quant.sf) and names (unique sample names) columns ;; skipMeta=Logical; if TRUE, skips adding ranges and metadata ;; assignRanges=Character; in summarizeToGene, can be "range" (default) or "abundant" (most abundant isoform) ;; type=Character; in importData, specifies the quantifier type (e.g., "oarfish") ;; txpData=GRanges or data.frame; in updateMetadata, used to manually add transcript metadata ;; ranges=Logical; in updateMetadata, if TRUE, populates rowRanges but removes transcripts without range information ;; divide=Logical; in DGEListFromTximeta, if TRUE, divides out quantification uncertainty for transcript-level analysis
- alternatives: tximport=The underlying package; prefer tximport directly or run tximeta with skipMeta=TRUE and a manual tx2gene table if using unsupported quantifiers, if no reference digest is available, or if running Salmon in alignment mode.
- when_to_use: Use when importing RNA-seq transcript quantifications from Salmon, Sailfish, alevin, or oarfish, and you want to automatically attach genomic coordinates (GRanges), transcript/gene metadata, and ensure computational reproducibility via reference sequence digests.
- pitfalls: Modifying or rearranging the output directory of the quantification tool (e.g., Salmon) will prevent tximeta from identifying the provenance of the reference transcripts ;; Missing transcripts in the GTF/GFF file that were present in the indexed FASTA will trigger a warning and be removed from the ranged SummarizedExperiment (can be bypassed with skipMeta=TRUE) ;; Using Salmon in alignment mode lacks an index, meaning there is no digest; skipMeta=TRUE must be used ;; For alevin, tximeta requires that it was run using gene IDs in the tgMap step, not gene symbols ;; linkedTxome and tximeta do not currently support multiple GTF/GFF files (users must combine them manually first).

workflows.name: salmon_import_and_summarization
workflows.intent: Import Salmon transcript quantifications, automatically attach metadata/ranges, and summarize to gene-level for downstream differential expression.
workflows.stages: 1. Prepare sample table with files and names columns ;; 2. Link custom transcriptome using makeLinkedTxome ;; 3. Import data using tximeta ;; 4. Retrieve database using retrieveDb ;; 5. Add exons using addExons ;; 6. Summarize to gene-level using summarizeToGene ;; 7. Add alternative identifiers using addIds ;; 8. Convert to downstream analysis objects (e.g., DGEListFromTximeta)
workflows.code:
dir <- system.file ( "extdata/salmon_dm" , package= "tximportData" )
files <- file.path (dir, "SRR1197474" , "quant.sf" )
coldata <- data.frame (files, names= "SRR1197474" , condition= "A" , stringsAsFactors= FALSE )
indexDir <- file.path (dir, "Dm.BDGP6.22.98_salmon-0.14.1" )
fastaFTP <- c ( "ftp://ftp.ensembl.org/pub/release-98/fasta/drosophila_melanogaster/cdna/Drosophila_melanogaster.BDGP6.22.cdna.all.fa.gz" , "ftp://ftp.ensembl.org/pub/release-98/fasta/drosophila_melanogaster/ncrna/Drosophila_melanogaster.BDGP6.22.ncrna.fa.gz" )
gtfPath <- file.path (dir, "Drosophila_melanogaster.BDGP6.22.98.gtf.gz" )
makeLinkedTxome ( indexDir= indexDir, source= "LocalEnsembl" , organism= "Drosophila melanogaster" , release= "98" , genome= "BDGP6.22" , fasta= fastaFTP, gtf= gtfPath, write= FALSE )
se <- tximeta (coldata)
edb <- retrieveDb (se)
se.exons <- addExons (se)
gse <- summarizeToGene (se)
gse <- addIds (gse, "REFSEQ" , gene= TRUE )
y <- DGEListFromTximeta (gse)

workflows.name: mixed_reference_oarfish_import
workflows.intent: Import and update metadata for mixed reference transcripts (annotated + novel) quantified with oarfish.
input: novel_gr (GRanges object containing novel transcript coordinates)
workflows.stages: 1. Prepare sample table with files and names columns ;; 2. Import un-ranged data using importData with type="oarfish" ;; 3. Inspect reference digests using inspectDigests ;; 4. Update metadata and optionally add ranges using updateMetadata ;; 5. Manually add novel transcript ranges using updateMetadata with txpData and ranges=TRUE
workflows.code:
dir <- system.file("extdata/oarfish", package="tximportData")
names <- paste0("rep", 2:4)
files <- file.path(dir, paste0("sgnex_h9_", names, ".quant.gz"))
coldata <- data.frame(files, names)
se <- importData(coldata, type="oarfish")
inspectDigests(se)
inspectDigests(se, fullDigest=TRUE)
se_update <- updateMetadata(se)
novel <- data.frame(
  seqnames = paste0("chr", rep(1:22, each = 500)),
  start = 1e6 + 1 + 0:499 * 1000,
  end = 1e6 + 1 + 0:499 * 1000 + 1000 - 1,
  strand = "+",
  tx_name = paste0("novel", 1:(22 * 500)),
  gene_id = paste0("novel_gene", rep(1:(22 * 10), each = 50)),
  type = "protein_coding"
)
library(GenomicRanges)
novel_gr <- as(novel, "GRanges")
names(novel_gr) <- novel$tx_name
se_with_ranges <- updateMetadata(se, txpData=novel_gr, ranges=TRUE)
